entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to an available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, Diana. I... I'm just so disappointed. I need to make a return. It's for the ClubFit Jersey I ordered.

I'm very sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can certainly help you with that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's just the fit. I ordered my usual size, but it's the wrong size for me. It's just... so uncomfortably too tight across the chest. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and this has never happened. I was so excited for it.
Oh, I completely understand that. Getting the perfect fit is crucial for a good ride. I see your order was delivered 18 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy for you.
Okay. I was thinking about an exchange, but honestly, with things being so tight this month, I really needed that money back. I was counting on this working out.
I've just checked, and since the ClubFit Jersey is a standard apparel item, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you, no problem at all.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. Thank you so much, Diana. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it.

Of course! And I see here that you're one of our VIP members. We truly value your loyalty, and I am very sorry for the sizing trouble. As a gesture of our apology, I've gone ahead and added a free expedited shipping voucher to your account for your next order.
Wow, you didn't have to do that. That's really kind. Thank you.

It's my pleasure. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to your email now. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Once we receive the jersey, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
